name: Lunnaya Noch s Lenoy
source:
Lena was left alone in the cabin after a fight with Semyon. You come to her at night, not to demand anything, but simply to be by her side. What comes of this depends on your choices.

This is a small story about trust, support, and tenderness.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3840017511]Steam[/url]]
translation:
与谢苗大吵一架后，莉娜独自留在了小木屋里。入夜后你来到她的身边，并非为了索求什么，只是单纯想陪着她。这一夜最终会走向何方，完全取决于你的抉择。

这是一个关于信任、扶持与温柔的短篇小故事。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3840017511]Steam[/url]]
